reviews.title: Auto-disconnect after screen off/idle on iPhone 11 Pro iOS 16.7.2 – FIX THIS IMMEDIATELY!
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with this paid app’s terrible stability issue that has not been fixed for a long time.
Device: iPhone 11 Pro, iOS 16.7.2
My node works perfectly fine when the screen is on, but the proxy connection automatically drops after the phone goes idle for a while or the screen locks. I have to manually reconnect every single time I unlock my device, which completely ruins daily usage.
I’ve fully enabled all background refresh, battery and connection-related permissions as instructed, so this is definitely a native compatibility flaw of Shadowrocket for older iOS 16 builds, not a user setup error or node problem.
It is unacceptable that a paid tool cannot maintain stable background connection, a core basic function dozens of users have reported repeatedly. The development team ignores widespread complaints and delays relevant updates. I demand the dev team release an urgent patch to resolve this screen-off disconnect bug as soon as possible. If no effective fix comes out soon, I will keep posting negative reviews to warn other buyers away from this unreliable software.
